entries.summary: Aurora guided the Dawnrise through the Miridian Rift while singing to stabilize the crew.
entries.details: Aurora led the crew through the Miridian Rift, using harmonic resonance to keep the ship intact.
quoted_dialogue: "Hold steady, Dawnrise—let the melody anchor you."
"Pilot Lys, can you sing us steady again?"

entries.summary: Aurora shared a first kiss with Erik on the Ferris wheel at the orbital carnival.
entries.details: During the Celestia carnival, Aurora and Erik shared a quiet moment atop the ferris wheel, promising to face the storms together.
quoted_dialogue: "No matter the storm, I’ll sing us home."
"Then I’ll chart the stars beside you."
